facts.value: 6.5 mm (maker Key Features and Specifications, both HD-5000 and HD5000BE pages). Manual stitch-setting lines read 'Stitch width: 3-6.5' (OCR)
facts.note: Our spec has 7 mm sourced to the maker page, but the maker page now says 6.5 mm. The 7 mm figure has no maker support: the '(5-7mm)' in accessory names is the foot's shank class, not the machine's width. This also removes the stitch-width gap versus the HD3000 that our spec's editorial claims (HD3000 page: 6.5 mm in Key Features, a stray '6mm maximum stitch width' line also appears).

facts.value: 'Limited 25 Year Warranty': 25 years from original purchase against defects in materials or workmanship, excluding electronic component parts (5 years) and labor (1 year free). Machines used commercially: 1 year parts and service. Excludes needles, needle plates, bobbin cases, fuses, light bulbs, knives, loopers, belts. Void if not bought from an authorized Janome dealer in the United States. Exclusive to original purchaser; receipt needed.
facts.spec_value: 25 yr materials and workmanship, 5 yr electrical, 1 yr labor
facts.note: Not model-specific: one Janome America warranty for the Product line. The Amazon listing quotes '25 year limited warranty mechanical parts, 2 year limited warranty electrical parts, 1 year limited labor' (2 years electrical vs the maker's 5) and Janome's page says it does not sell direct, with the warranty void for non-authorized-dealer purchases.

site.label: Warranty
site.juki: 25 yr materials and workmanship; 5 yr electronic parts; 1 yr labor; 1 yr if used commercially; authorized US dealer purchase only
